expanded_accounting.interpretation: These are normalized observation/session accounting units across baseline plus overlay. They are not prediction hits, prophecy counts, or independent empirical confirmations.

important_nonindependence: C030 and C033 add distinct clock-event roots but share the same salience/lookup selection process as the baseline clock family; they must not be modeled as IID minute draws.
C031 adds one experiment/session root, not one root per early or late timing trial.
C032 adds zero because its 03:03 root is already in NP-003.
C035 adds chronology/reference structure but zero phenomenology roots.
C034 remains low-resolution because later autobiographical testimony is not equivalent to a contemporaneous preregistered receipt.

hidden_patterns_after_overlay.reading: The cases that look most temporally uncanny are also those where the observation is most entangled with clock salience, scheduler/Git semantics, retrospective autobiographical memory, or creative repository continuity. This makes provenance and selection modeling more important, not less.
The strongest auditable facts are generally frozen earlier states and later comparisons. Public, specific, preregistered future-event forecasts are not what survives normalization.

Records with higher risk of extraordinary interpretation tend to carry stronger explicit claim ceilings. This is primarily a project authoring/safety property and must not be mistaken for an external-world causal law.

Atomic normalization reveals more descriptive subevents and event roots inside some families, while simultaneously collapsing pseudo-replication across shared sources, selections and lineages. More detail does not mean more evidence.
